build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
build_task_scene: build a physics scene with a slope, platform, container, and dynamic balls using build_task
add_convex_polygon_slope: add a convex polygon to the scene representing a slope using C.add_convex_polygon
add_container_goal: add a container as the goal target using vt.add_container with vertex coordinates
update_task_relationship: update the task goal to require a ball touching the container using C.update_task
